_comment: Fishing hotspots (see docs/design/fishing.md). Numbers: radius in blocks; durations and cooldowns in seconds; spawn_chance_per_second is rolled each second for a player who holds a rod (cooldown applies per player); min_depth/min_fill = the water must be at least this deep under this share of the circle. Buff stats: fishing_speed, fishing_fortune, sea_creature_chance (points), double_catch, rare_finds (percent).
